statement: No shadow window passes on missing evidence: an instance that reported on a window and has no report is waited for, and at the longest window the window closes insufficient, naming it; it never closes passing on the others' reports. What a pass saw of a window is written only to the record of that window, with the reporters the record already names: a change staged again meanwhile keeps its new window open, and two passes that overlap each keep the instances the other saw (DR1-E-6).
